successBar: Context pressure must come from the active runtime's own token evidence or remain explicitly unmeasured; auxiliary model calls and filesystem size may never masquerade as interactive context.
Every startup signal must preserve typed state, freshness, and source provenance; green-qualified statuses, zero-denominator history, stale caches, and public-repo fallbacks must render honestly.
Propagated Studio runtime code must prove compatibility against PromoGrind's live contracts after every sync, with local deltas explicit and upstream defects routed by signed Ark cargo.
Every write-admission and lease receipt must attribute the actual current project and fail closed only for the correct project identity.

items.title: Make the context meter read Codex's exact live token-count events instead of promoting auxiliary-call heuristics
items.axis: observability / token efficiency / session safety / agent parity
items.why: The meter's S262 honesty gate still sets measured_ok=true whenever any auxiliary Studio model call exists, even when usedTokens remains the filesystem heuristic. During this session it reported 7,943/272,000 (2.9%) while the active Codex transcript exposed a runtime token-count event at 148,558 input tokens with a 258,400-token window.
items.evidence: scripts/context-meter.mjs defines hasRealMeasurement as ledger.length > 0 || interactive.length > 0 || proxy, but its own output contract says Studio API ledger rows do not include the interactive conversation. CODEX_THREAD_ID identifies the active ~/.codex/sessions JSONL; its latest event_msg/token_count contains last_token_usage.input_tokens and model_context_window. Non-JSON UNMEASURED output also dereferences null with toLocaleString().
items.recipe: Extract a pure Codex transcript probe that validates session_meta.id and cwd, finds the active thread file, tail-parses the newest token_count event, and returns exact input tokens plus runtime window. Prefer it over heuristics, remove auxiliary ledger rows from measured_ok, preserve honest UNMEASURED behavior when no runtime evidence exists, make text rendering null-safe, and add adversarial fixtures for foreign threads, malformed tails, stale auxiliary ledgers, over-limit readings, and runtime-window override.
items.timeToFirstValue: The next meter run in this session reports the real Codex context pressure and can genuinely govern whether the arc continues.

L1.recipe: Stop counting auxiliary ledger presence as interactive measurement.

L2.recipe: L1 plus active CODEX_THREAD_ID JSONL token-count parsing and runtime-window override.

L3.recipe: L2 plus a pure probe module, foreign/malformed/over-limit fixtures, null-safe text output, and source-attributed machine receipts.

executionLog.result: The meter now binds CODEX_THREAD_ID to the active repo transcript, reads the provider-native token_count event and runtime window, excludes auxiliary model ledgers from measured_ok, and renders honest nulls.
verification: 8/8 focused Codex probe and SIL contracts

items.title: Bind scheduled-write and session-lease decisions to the actual repository identity
items.why: A write-admission receipt attributed a PromoGrind execution to studio-ops. Wrong-project attribution weakens the exact concurrency and cross-repo safety boundary the new session beacon is intended to enforce.
items.evidence: Running node scripts/check-scheduled-write-admission.mjs --json from PromoGrind returned project=studio-ops. The source defaults project to the literal 'studio-ops' instead of deriving path.basename(ROOT). The beacon check itself honestly reports unconfigured when BEACON_GIST_ID is missing.
items.recipe: Derive the default project slug from the current repository root, normalize explicit --project input, carry root/project/trigger/writeMode through every allow and deny receipt, fail on empty or path-shaped project identifiers, and add direct CLI fixtures proving PromoGrind attribution, explicit override, scheduled telemetry, scheduled Git denial without policy, and unconfigured-beacon honesty.
items.timeToFirstValue: The next scheduled-write decision can no longer claim the wrong repository owner.

L1.recipe: Replace the hardcoded default with the current root basename.

L2.recipe: L1 plus normalized explicit project input and receipt provenance.

L3.recipe: L2 plus pure decision helpers and CLI fixtures across interactive/scheduled/git/unconfigured-beacon paths.

executionLog.result: Write admission derives promogrind from the repository root, normalizes explicit overrides, and carries root/project/trigger/write-mode provenance through allow and deny receipts.
verification: scheduled Git path fails closed without policy
executionLog.telemetrySource: direct CLI and pure helper contracts

items.title: Turn propagation from a blind file mirror into a consumer-verified compatibility receipt
items.axis: infrastructure / test depth / ecosystem coherence / root-cause prevention
items.why: Thirty-four inherited modules were exact Studio Ops mirrors, but two local contracts immediately regressed: the SIL forecaster stopped exporting canonical CATEGORIES and stopped rejecting incomplete ledgers, and the startup renderer dropped the public-repo revenue fallback. A byte-identical propagation receipt is not proof that the consumer remains correct.
items.evidence: SHA-256 comparison found 34 exact Studio Ops mirrors and one locally repaired forecaster. Direct Vitest failed at src/__tests__/silForecaster.test.js before repair. npm run test:session-invariants then failed its public-repo revenue-source invariant before repair. Both isolated surfaces now pass, proving consumer-specific compatibility requirements are real.
items.recipe: Create a deterministic compatibility ratchet that enumerates the propagated runtime surface, syntax-checks every module, records exact-mirror versus documented-local-override state, and executes consumer contracts for SIL parsing, public revenue fallback, context evidence, write attribution, and startup rendering. Emit a machine JSON receipt, integrate it into test:session-invariants, and ship a signed Ark defect report to Studio Ops instead of editing the sibling tree.
items.timeToFirstValue: The next propagation sync fails at the exact consumer contract it breaks, before a false brief or closeout receipt can ship.

L1.recipe: Add a source manifest and syntax checks for the changed runtime surface.

L2.recipe: L1 plus behavioral compatibility assertions for the two proven regressions.

L3.recipe: L2 plus exact-mirror/local-override classification, machine receipt, package integration, and signed upstream defect cargo.

executionLog.result: A 35-module consumer ratchet syntax-checks the propagated surface, classifies exact mirrors versus documented overrides, behavior-checks the repaired contracts, and emits a machine receipt.

items.title: Give the startup brief one typed, freshness-aware signal semantics layer
items.axis: UI feedback / observability / organization / release truth
items.why: The founder brief rendered a red icon beside a green-qualified truth status, treated an April 0/0 compliance snapshot as a current failure, trusted an expired project-profile cache with contradictory Stripe readiness, omitted repo-local revenue evidence until repaired, and hardcodes a Studio Ops test command even though PromoGrind's canonical suite is npm test.
items.evidence: docs/STARTUP_BRIEF.md showed Truth green-repo-owned... with ⛔, Compliance 0/0 (0%) with ⛔, Revenue not found, and a cached tool lens. scripts/render-startup-brief.mjs compares truthStatus only to exact 'green'/'yellow', accepts any last compliance snapshot without denominator/freshness checks, reads project-profile.json without generatedAt/ttlMs validation, and tells stale app repos to run scripts/run-tests.mjs rather than deriving testingSurfaces/package.json.
items.recipe: Extract pure signal semantics for qualified truth states, meaningful compliance denominators and freshness, cache expiry plus canonical-status fallback, public/private revenue source selection, and project-specific test remediation. Render explicit unknown/not-tracked states instead of red, preserve source labels, add table-driven tests, rerender the brief, and validate the canonical box format.
items.timeToFirstValue: The next startup brief no longer contradicts its own source values or send the founder to the wrong recovery command.

L1.recipe: Fix truth prefix mapping and reject 0/0 compliance as a failure.

L2.recipe: L1 plus cache freshness and source-derived test command.

L3.recipe: L2 plus one pure signal-semantics module, table-driven fixtures, public revenue fallback, and canonical rendered-output verification.

executionLog.result: Startup signal semantics now preserve qualified truth states, reject zero/stale compliance evidence, ignore expired profile claims, derive the app test command, and retain public revenue fallback.

innovationReserve: Read active Codex token_count events as a provider-native, agent-parity context gauge rather than estimating conversation size from repository bytes.
Treat propagation as a consumer contract with exact-mirror/local-override receipts, not as evidence that copied bytes are behaviorally compatible.
Make every founder-facing signal a typed state carrying value, source, freshness, and confidence before it can choose an icon.
